title: 🧱 Why Stability Is the Missing Piece in Most Relationships (And How to Build It)
summary: This article explores why so many relationships feel harder than they should—and pinpoints the real reason: most couples were never taught how to build a strong emotional foundation. It walks through the three core elements of that foundation: Emotional Regulation, Emotional Safety & Security, and Consistency & Reliability. Readers learn how these building blocks restore clarity, trust, and connection—and why trying to grow a relationship without them can leave even loving couples feeling stuck. Designed to offer both insight and momentum, the article gives practical first steps for anyone ready to stop feeling stuck and start creating real change.
